title: Colibrì: runs a 744B parameter frontier model on 25GB RAM in pure C

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Calibri runs a 744 billion parameter model on a laptop with 25 GB of RAM in pure C with zero dependencies. A model that size normally wants hundreds of gigabytes of memory or a rack of GPUs you'll never own. The authors blunt that it's slow, roughly a tenth of a token per second on his humble box. But it's a Frontier model answering correctly on hardware cheaper than an H100's
